card.grid_help: Repeats the drawing across the sheet inside its margins, turning each copy to fit if that packs more in. Scaling decides whether the whole page or the drawn lines alone fill each cell. Horizontal and vertical spacing pad every side of every copy — doubling between neighbours and leaving a matching margin at the sheet edge. No line optimization is applied. Reversible — turn it off to get the single drawing back.
card.grid_cut_marks_help: Trim marks between copies only, in a layer of their own that always plots: a 1 mm tick where a cut between two copies reaches the sheet edge, a 2 mm cross where two cuts meet between four. Nothing on the sheet's own corners or edges.
optimize.expert_note: Each ticked box runs its vpype command, in order, when you press Execute. Optimization does not run automatically at plot time in this mode — press Execute again after changing a box.
optimize.expert_no_command: Tick at least one box and enter a command.
export.note: As a plot lays it down: selected layers, placed on the page with this job's size, margins and transform. G-code and HPGL also carry the active machine's axis-skew correction (set its profile in Settings); SVG, PNG and PDF stay square.

settings.machine.title: Machine
settings.machine.note: Measure what the pen can actually reach — the bed is the whole machine here, and anything past it is clipped at plot time. The presets are only starting points: rename, resize or delete any of them.
settings.machine.paper_origin_label: Paper origin (mm from the bed corner)
settings.machine.paper_origin_note: Where the top-left corner of your paper usually sits on the bed. Shown as the white sheet on the grey bed in every preview, and the spot the ⇱ button jogs the carriage to. Keep it a little off 0, 0 so a skew or nudge correction has room before the near edge — it is not the plot origin, "Set origin here" still is.
settings.machine.skew_note: How far this machine's two axes are out of square, measured with the calculator below, and which axis is the straight one the other is corrected against. Applied to plots. Leave the angle at 0 unless you've measured a skew.
settings.machine.skew_clearance_none: At 0° nothing skew-related touches a plot: artwork, manual jogs, origin nudges and Return to Origin all pass through unchanged.
settings.machine.skew_clearance: A4 portrait (210 × 297 mm) needs {a4} mm of margin at the {side}; A3 portrait (297 × 420 mm) needs {a3} mm.
settings.machine.skew_clearance_absorb: Shrink to fit acts only when the measured ink really would overrun, and then scales it uniformly about the page centre — the same factor on both axes, so nothing is deformed and nothing slides sideways. Artwork filling the bed shrinks {pct}%, leaving {margin} mm of paper at each of the two edges; anything with room to spare is left untouched.
settings.machine.skew_mode_note: Correcting a nonzero skew angle can push ink past the page edge. Clip keeps artwork at its declared size and lets that ink clip. Shrink to fit reserves room and scales artwork down so nothing clips.
settings.machine.skew_calc_summary: Work it out from a test square
settings.machine.skew_calc_note: Plot a square, then measure it corner to corner. Both diagonals equal means no skew and nothing to correct.
settings.machine.skew_calc_incomplete: Enter the side length and both diagonals.
settings.machine.skew_calc_too_large: That works out past ±5° — check the measurements, or the machine needs squaring up first.
settings.machine.skew_calc_result: Skew is {deg}° — saved when you press Save.

camera.picture.title: Image Quality
camera.picture.shutter_note: If the live view wobbles while the pen is moving, that's motion blur/rolling-shutter skew, not a bug. "Short" biases auto-exposure toward a faster shutter; for full manual control set a fixed shutter speed (try 2000-8000) — 0 leaves it automatic.
camera.picture.exposure_interaction_note: Exposure mode and exposure compensation (EV) bias auto-exposure — once a fixed shutter speed above is set, their effect may be reduced or absent. If the picture still looks too dark or bright with a fixed shutter, Gain / ISO is the more reliable manual lever.
camera.picture.flip_note: If the camera is mounted upside down, check both to rotate the image 180°.

camera.recording.rclone_delete_local: Delete local recording once the upload to the rclone target is confirmed
camera.recording.retention_gb_label: Keep at most (GB of recordings, 0 = keep everything)
camera.recording.retention_gb_note: Once the folder goes over this, the oldest recordings are deleted each time a new one finishes. A recording still waiting to upload is never deleted.
camera.recording.files_delete_note: Recordings are deleted from the Pi once the upload is confirmed, so this list is normally empty. Anything still here has an upload that hasn't landed yet.
camera.recording.files_keep_note: Recordings are kept on the Pi after being uploaded.
camera.recording.files_no_target: No rclone target set — recordings stay on the Pi.
camera.recording.files_no_rclone: rclone is not installed on the Pi — recordings stay local.
